context: Tests whether the craft skill maintains agent isolation by using separate agents for Write Test, Implement, and Validate, dispatching them synchronously, and reading context from beads issues.

checklist.name: Separate agents
checklist.description: Distinct Task agents are used for Write Test, Implement, and Validate phases

checklist.name: Synchronous dispatch
checklist.description: TDD agents within a phase are dispatched sequentially, not in background

checklist.name: Issues closed on gates
checklist.description: Beads issues are closed only after their gate conditions are verified as passing

checklist.name: Reads from beads
checklist.description: Agent context is read from beads issues, not the plan file

checklist.name: No shared context
checklist.description: Each agent starts fresh with full context from the beads issue, not prior agent outputs
